Detailed Description

View class for tab bar buttons.

This view class provides a view for a button that's placed in a tab bar. In comparison to standard button reacting on mouse release, it reacts on mouse press, just like tabs in common toolkits.

In order for this view to work correctly, the button must be checkable.
